# =============================================================================
# pmu component — IEEE C37.118.1 P-class and M-class TWLS phasor tasks
#
# Sources:
#   src/task_twls_pmu_p.c   P-class TWLS task (Priority 2, N=481, 49-51 Hz LUT)
#   src/task_twls_pmu_m.c   M-class TWLS task (Priority 3, N=961, 47.5-52.5 Hz LUT)
#   src/lut/twls_bank_p.c   P-class LUT bank — AUTO-GENERATED (41 × 6 × 481 float32)
#   src/lut/twls_bank_m.c   M-class LUT bank — AUTO-GENERATED (101 × 6 × 961 float32)
#
# Generate LUT files before building:
#   python3 ../../tools/gen_twls_lut.py --out-dir src/lut/
#
# Dependencies: pow_buf (include), FreeRTOS, CMSIS-DSP (arm_math)
# =============================================================================

target_include_directories(${MCUX_SDK_PROJECT_NAME} PUBLIC
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include
)

target_sources(${MCUX_SDK_PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/task_twls_pmu_p.c
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/task_twls_pmu_m.c
    # LUT files — generated by tools/gen_twls_lut.py; must exist before cmake runs.
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/lut/twls_bank_p.c
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/lut/twls_bank_m.c
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Optional: add a custom target to (re-)generate LUT files on demand.
# Requires Python 3 + numpy in the build environment.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
find_program(PYTHON3 python3)
if(PYTHON3)
    add_custom_target(gen_twls_lut
        COMMAND ${PYTHON3}
                ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/tools/gen_twls_lut.py
                --out-dir ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/lut/
        COMMENT "Generating TWLS LUT C files (P-class and M-class)…"
        VERBATIM
    )
    message(STATUS "PMU: LUT regeneration target 'gen_twls_lut' available  (ninja gen_twls_lut)")
else()
    message(WARNING "PMU: python3 not found — run gen_twls_lut.py manually before building")
endif()
